--- Page 1 (Beckerman_24a) --- Dear Folks and Ruth, Received your March 9th letter a few days ago in the new monogrammed stationary. I notice you went on sending June packages. If you do send anything to Abe I shouldn't send anything but canned foods. That's the only thing that will come thru safely. Some of these packages are still coming thru. However, all but canned foods are not fit to even be touched. So don't send anything but cans. And that isn't advisable either if it takes too many persons ration coupons. I do enjoy Ruth's letters very much even though I don't do them justice in my answers. All the little things that go on here are especially significant and meaningful over here. I'm glad that the house question was decided the way it was. It's made me feel I was in a waste of my energy. I still haven't heard from Abe. --- Page 2 (Beckerman_24b) --- 2. envelope some miscellaneous photographs I have lying around and a souvenir folder. I trust they will make worthwhile additions to our collections. Shot a roll of film at the beach last weekend and that should be coming thru in about a week. That's all for the present. am getting on as fine as ever. Jack
Archivist notes
The letter appears to be from a soldier or someone stationed away from home, given the context of the home front and the mention of ration coupons. The sender's location is not specified, but the content suggests they are far from home.
